detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

It took actually 4 (!!) prompts to make a realtime audio multi-timbral/sound ESP32 FM-synthesis tracker composer/player for T-Pager. Flawless audio, good UI. Everything works and I could compose nice pattern. 

This is just absolute nuts. 

It would have taken multiple week evenings to write manually.  And would require mastering many skills too; microcontroller+realtime, audio synthesis, gfx (DMA). Totally not the easiest task to get right. #ai #genai #llm #agenticai
